panels.title: Backend telemetry age
panels.description: The API process uptime proves the selected backend release is still publishing metrics.

panels.title: Frontend telemetry records
panels.description: Privacy-safe Faro measurements received during the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({kind=~"measurement|measurements"} | json | app_name="dear-diary-client" | app_environment=~"${environment:regex}" [$__range])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Frontend exceptions
panels.description: Faro exceptions received during the selected time range. Any increase should be checked by release.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({kind=~"exception|exceptions"} | json | app_name="dear-diary-client" | app_environment=~"${environment:regex}" [$__range])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Client push outcomes
panels.description: Successful and failed synchronization pushes from Faro measurements.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (sum_over_time({kind=~"measurement|measurements"} | json | app_name="dear-diary-client" | app_environment=~"${environment:regex}" | type=~"deardiary\\.sync\\.push\\.(success|failure)" | unwrap value_value | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Client pull outcomes
panels.description: Successful and failed synchronization pulls from Faro measurements.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (sum_over_time({kind=~"measurement|measurements"} | json | app_name="dear-diary-client" | app_environment=~"${environment:regex}" | type=~"deardiary\\.sync\\.pull\\.(success|failure)" | unwrap value_value | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Frontend signals by release
panels.description: Measurement rate grouped by the Faro application version embedded at build time.
